# Upstream

- Project: [nutlope/hallmark](https://github.com/nutlope/hallmark)
- Version: 1.1.0
- Commit: `aeb42fb354ff4efa36ab475773a082315a3af2ce`
- Canonical content: `skills/hallmark/SKILL.md` and `skills/hallmark/references/**`
- Vendored content: `SKILL.md` and `references/**` (106 files, byte-for-byte)
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Hallmark contributors

The upstream demo site and unrelated documentation are intentionally excluded. To
update Hallmark, copy the canonical content from a newly pinned commit and verify
every vendored file byte-for-byte before changing this metadata.

Because canonical files are unchanged, they retain 13 relative links to excluded
upstream demo-site assets (11) and human-only documentation (2). All references
within the vendored skill scope resolve.
